thread:
tom_support: heads up — ACME reported that per-model throughput panels in the Console are showing a single flatline for all models since last night. Customer impact: UI shows no per-model variability, customers think routing is broken.
katie_cs: escalated from the customer at 22:17 PST, they attached a screenshot and said all model rows show identical QPS of 0.0 except the total. :frowning:
rahul_sre: any deploys around the time the graphs went quiet?
eva_eng: we shipped a metrics relabel refactor in the exporter yesterday 21:30 to normalize namespaces and remove noisy labels. Could be related.
metrics-bot: new deploy: metrics-exporter v2.4.1 by eva_eng at 2024-11-15T21:31:02Z
tom_support: repro steps from customer: open Console -> Model throughput -> select time range last 12h -> all model rows show flatline. They tried refresh and different org accounts, same.
rahul_sre: quick check: run PromQL on prod prometheus: `sum(rate(model_request_count[5m])) by (model_id)` — does that return multiple series or a single series?
eva_eng: ran the query in prod, got a single series grouped by `instance` not `model_id`. Looks like `model_id` got dropped during relabel.
katie_cs: omg — that explains the UI group-by being unable to split series. Customer-facing screenshots match that timeline. They've asked for ETA on fix.
rahul_sre: immediate mitigation: update exporter relabel config to preserve `model_id`. I can patch it, redeploy to staging, smoke test prom queries, then rollout to prod. ETA ~40m if nothing blocks.
metrics-bot: ALERT: prom scrape target metrics-exporter changed label set at 2024-11-15T21:30:45Z — labels removed: model_id
eva_eng: config diff: removed legacy `__tmp` label mapping but accidentally dropped `labels_to_keep: [model_id]`. I'll prepare a one-line fix in the Helm chart.
tom_support: please also ping ACME and give a short repro + workaround: they can query the global total `sum(rate(model_request_count[5m]))` until fix.
rahul_sre: patch created: https://git.internal/r/inference/metrics-exporter/commit/6a7b3f2 — adds `keep_labels: ["model_id","env"]` to relabel stage. Applying to staging now.
eva_eng: staging redeploy successful. PromQL check: `count(sum(rate(model_request_count[5m])) by (model_id))` returns multiple series in staging, graphs look restored locally.
rahul_sre: rolling patch to prod with canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%, monitoring QPS and scrape errors.
deploy-bot: rollout started for metrics-exporter v2.4.2-canary at 2024-11-16T00:10:12Z
metrics-bot: prometheus: new series detected grouped by model_id at 2024-11-16T00:22:00Z
katie_cs: pinged ACME with status and suggested they clear Console cache and re-open the panel. They responded: "thanks — graphs look correct now, per-model lines returned." :white_check_mark:
rahul_sre: post-mortem notes: root cause = relabel refactor unintentionally dropped `model_id`. Contributing factors: lack of e2e dashboard smoke test and missing canary guard for label-count diffs.
eva_eng: action items: (1) add a Prometheus unit test ensuring `model_id` preserved, (2) add dashboard smoke check in health checks, (3) add a pre-deploy alert if series count for `model_request_count` changes by >30% during canary.
tom_support: ACME is satisfied and reopened the ticket as resolved. I'll close once the post-mortem doc is up. Thanks everyone. :pray:
rahul_sre: creating incident postmortem ticket: INC-2024-0429, assigning to eva_eng for patch verification and to katie_cs for customer comms."
